_comment: Both clauses gated on REF_PITCH_IS with refs named ATTACK_ACTION and NON_ATTACK_ACTION -- names nothing ever stores, and REF_PITCH_IS tests a PITCH VALUE rather than a card type, so neither clause could ever fire. 'Pitched to play it' is PITCHED_FOR_THIS (play._pitch_for_cost stamps the cards on the played card), not the pitch zone and not the attack pitch.
